name: PollingPublisher
summary: Publishes the messages an outbox holds by polling the table for them, which works on any database and buys that with a poll interval and an ordering problem.

roles.name: PollingPublisher
roles.summary: Reads the outbox on a timer and publishes what it finds. Working against any SQL database is its whole argument; what it costs is latency the rest of the system inherits, and an order that is tricky to guarantee once more than one instance is polling.
